summary: unexpected TOKEN, expected one of: LIST
help: Remove the token, or replace it with one of the listed tokens.
rationale: A token that no rule of the current mode accepts stops the parse, so the remainder of the statement cannot be read.

help: Start the line with a node, an edge, or a flowchart statement such as style or subgraph.
rationale: A line whose first token starts no statement form would otherwise become a phantom node with a meaningless shape.

help: Close the opening delimiter before the end of the input.
rationale: The input ends inside an open construct, so no complete statement exists for it.

summary: node bracket TOKEN is never closed
help: Add the closing bracket that matches the opening bracket.
rationale: A node shape whose bracket never closes leaves the label text and the rest of the line undelimited.

summary: subgraph direction is ignored because an edge crosses its boundary
help: Remove the direction statement, or move the crossing edge outside the subgraph.
rationale: A subgraph whose direction differs from its parent cannot keep that direction while an edge crosses its boundary, so the parent orientation decides the layout.
